item.title: Teen Love Turned Into A Terrifying Murder
item.description: Eighteen-year-old Rose Larner disappeared in Lansing, Michigan, after meeting her on-and-off boyfriend John Ortiz-Kehoe and childhood friend Billy Brown in December 1993. Kehoe was convicted of her murder after Brown became a key witness, but conflicting accounts surrounding Rose's final night have kept questions about the case alive decades later.

item.title: He Was Fatally Attacked Then Somehow Finished His Morning Routine
item.description: Peter Porco was struck 16 times with an axe while asleep, yet survived for hours and somehow carried out parts of his normal morning routine before collapsing and dying. His son Christopher was later convicted of murdering him and attempting to murder his mother, Joan, in the 2004 attack.

item.title: She Wanted Her Freedom And Her Daughter Vanished
item.description: Casey Anthony's two-year-old daughter, Caylee, disappeared in 2008 and was later found dead near the family's Florida home. Prosecutors argued Casey wanted freedom from motherhood, but she was acquitted of murder and manslaughter at trial, while being convicted of lying to investigators.

item.title: After 38 Years, She Learned A Dark Secret About Her Husband
item.description: Corinna Smith learned devastating allegations about her husband, Michael Baines, shortly before she attacked him while he slept. She poured boiling water mixed with sugar over him, causing severe burns that proved fatal weeks later. Smith was convicted of murder and sentenced to life in prison with a minimum of 12 years.

item.title: Has Emma Fillipoff Been Found?!
item.description: Emma Fillipoff disappeared outside Victoria's Empress Hotel in November 2012 after police spoke with her for 45 minutes. Thirteen years later, she still has not been found, and her case has been moved to Victoria Police's Historical Case Review Unit. A new documentary released in 2026 is revisiting the search for answers.

item.title: Why Ghislaine Maxwell’s Interview Made So Many People Uncomfortable
item.description: Ghislaine Maxwell's 2025 Justice Department interview drew intense scrutiny because the convicted Epstein accomplice repeatedly praised powerful figures while denying she had witnessed inappropriate behavior. Her claims about Epstein's so-called client list and the circumstances surrounding the interview raised further questions about what she knew and what she was willing to reveal.

item.title: Why Did A Custody Hearing Raise New Suspicions?
item.description: Anna Kepner's death aboard a Carnival cruise was already under FBI investigation when a separate custody dispute brought startling details into public view. Court filings identified her 16-year-old stepbrother as a suspect, while testimony raised questions about what happened aboard the ship and why he was later removed from the family home.

item.title: The Haunted Town Buried Beneath Lake Lanier
item.description: Beneath Georgia's Lake Lanier lies the site of Oscarville, a historically Black community whose residents were violently displaced decades before the valley was flooded to create the reservoir. Today, the lake is surrounded by stories of unexplained deaths, submerged structures, and ghostly sightings—but there is no evidence that the lake is actually haunted.
